IF(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime )) > 12 && LEN(TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime ))))=1, TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime )) - 12) & ':'& TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime )))& '0 PM', IF(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime )) > 12 && LEN(TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime ))))>1, TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime )) - 12) & ':'& TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime )))& ' PM', IF(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime )) <= 12 && LEN(TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime ))))=1, TEXT(HOUR( TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime ) )) & ':'& TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime )))& '0 AM', TEXT(HOUR( TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime ) )) & ':'& TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedStartTime )))& ' AM') ) ) &
' to '
&
IF(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime )) > 12 && LEN(TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime ))))=1, TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime )) - 12) & ':'& TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime )))& '0 PM', IF(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime )) > 12 && LEN(TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime ))))>1, TEXT(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime )) - 12) & ':'& TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime )))& ' PM', IF(HOUR(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime )) <= 12 && LEN(TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime ))))=1, TEXT(HOUR( TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime ) )) & ':'& TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime )))& '0 AM', TEXT(HOUR( TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime ) )) & ':'& TEXT(MINUTE(TIMEVALUE(SchedEndTime )))& ' AM') ) )
